'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Russian legislative election]]
**[[Central Election Commission (Russia)|Russian election commission]] chairperson [[Ella Pamfilova]] reports [[cyberattack]]s targeting [[Russia]]'s [[online voting]] system during the second day of the [[State Duma|parliamentary]] election and says they are repelled. The [[Minkomsvyaz]] separately reports thwarting a sabotage attempt on [[Russian Far East|Far Eastern]] communication lines.
